title: CS daily scratchpad - QBR + renewals follow-ups (Mar 20)
content:
Daily scratchpad - quick hits for QBRs, renewals, and open support follow-ups

TODAY (Mar 20) priorities:
- [ ] ACME CORP QBR (10:30am PT) - final prep + deck notes
    - quick wins: latency improvement (50ms), cost down by 12% after batching change
    - open ask: dedicated capacity pricing proposal (show 3-tier commit options)
    - slides to update: slide 3 (throughput chart), slide 7 (next steps + action owners)
    - ask Jordan to add the canary rollout timeline (Slack DM: @Jordan Lee)

- [ ] ORBITAL HEALTH renewal touchpoint (2pm PT) - pricing negotiation call
    - current ARR: $180k/yr, renewal due Jun 1
    - goal: move to 12-month reserved (Committed) with 10% uplift vs current usage
    - risks: procurement wants SOC2 audit evidence (send certs + compliance one-pager)
    - action: send contract redline to Priya by EOD Mar 21

- [ ] BRIGHTOPS support follow-ups
    - open tickets: SUPPORT-3245 (embedding mismatch on prod), SUPPORT-3280 (timeout spikes)
    - note: SUPPORT-3245 repro steps in ticket, asked infra to attach logs; follow up with infra @Alex
    - quick workaround: reduce batch size to 8 for the endpoint (verified staging)

Notes / talking points for ACME QBR deck:
- Intro: thanks + usage snapshot (Feb 1 - Mar 15): 1.2B tokens, 14% monthly growth
- Performance: median p95 latency improved from 420ms -> 370ms after kv-cache + batching tweaks
- Cost: per-1M-token cost down 12% from model swap + quantization profile; show actual $/month
- Reliability: 99.95% availability last quarter (call out two incident blips in Feb; root cause = autoscaler misconfig)
- Roadmap asks: dedicated capacity pilot, private VPC option evaluation, long-term SLA
- Ask: get renewal decision by Apr 10 to align procurement timelines

Quick reminders / to-dos (not urgent):
- [ ] Update the QBR templates in Confluence with new throughput charts (link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CS/QBR+Template)
- [ ] Upload ACME usage CSV to shared drive for finance (folder: shared_drives/customer-success/renewals/)
- [ ] Prep one-pager on Dedicated vs Hosted cost tradeoffs (use from product: /product/dedicated/cheatsheet)

Questions / unresolved:
- Do we have an up-to-date SOC2 snapshot to share with Orbital Health procurement? (asked security on Mar 18, no reply)
- ACME procurement asked for an MSA clause sample for data residency - who owns this? Legal or CS? Pinged legal@redwood last week

Slack / comms to send today:
- DM @Jordan Lee: please add canary timeline to ACME deck + brief note on rollback policy
- Thread #cs-acme-thread: drop updated slide deck and call recording after QBR
- DM @Priya Natarajan: confirm contract redline timeline for Orbital Health (need by EOD Mar 21)
- Ping #infra-runbooks: request logs for SUPPORT-3245 (include trace id in ticket)

End-of-day checklist:
- [ ] All slides uploaded to Confluence + share link to ACME stakeholders
- [ ] Notes + action items captured in ACME Jira epic (ACME-130)
- [ ] Renewal email to Orbital Health procurement drafted and queued

Notes to self (scratchy):
- Keep playback short in QBR - execs want top-level metrics + 3 asks (cost, SLA, dedicated pilot)
- If Orbital pushes back on price, propose a 6mo bridge deal with a usage-based floor
- Follow up on SOC2 snapshot with security lead (Maya Ortiz)

Misc context snippets:
- ACME stakeholder list: Samir Patel (CTO), Lisa Huang (Head of ML), Rajesh Iyer (Procurement)
- BrightOps support owner: Alex Chen, escalation path -> Jordan Lee -> SRE on-call

Scratch/brainstorm ideas for renewals playbook:
- Standardized renewal email template (customizable: ARR, renewal date, key wins)
- Pricing playbook: 6/12/24 month commit tiers + pilot discounts for Dedicated
- Compliance kit: SOC2 + privacy + on-demand architecture diagram to speed procurement

End.
